title: svelte-grab audit findings
description: Findings of a svelte-grab security/performance audit. The finding shape is the one ui_security_scan returns (docs/agent-runtime-spec.md 9b) and svelte-grab audit emits (9c). Static findings from `svelte-grab audit` (src/cli/audit/finding-schema.json) also carry rule, file, line and column and validate here too.

tool.description: What produced the findings, e.g. "svelte-grab audit", "ui_security_scan", "svelte-grab-audit skill".

verdict.description: confirmed needs reproduction evidence; needs_validation must name the missing fact. Disproved candidates are not findings.

evidence.description: Redacted evidence. Secrets appear only as kind:abcd…(len N, sha xxxxxx), never in full.

rule.description: Static rule id from svelte-grab audit, e.g. secrets/client-exposure.

check.description: ui_security_scan check (transit, storage, ...) or CHECKLIST.md id (S1, P4, ...).

screen.description: Route of the screen the finding was observed on.

missingFact.description: For needs_validation: the exact fact that would confirm or reject it.
